propositions: test_a_missing_epic_field_aborts_provisioning sleeps for ~120 seconds against the full production readiness budget because the stub returns an incomplete field set that can never satisfy the readiness check

The readiness poll loop in await_required_fields performs ~120 iterations (one per second) before expiry, each with a real sleep, consuming production timing constants rather than a test-scoped budget
The production code already supports environment variable JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT to override the default 120-second budget, but the test does not use it
With a zero budget, the poll loop deterministically terminates after exactly one attempt before entering sleep, because the deadline check monotonic() >= deadline is true on first expiry

Injecting a fake sleep/monotonic pair is not viable because _assert_project_capabilities does not forward such injectable parameters to await_required_fields, requiring an unwanted production signature change
